purpose: Everything a later regeneration needs to prove the committed API client matches its input: the toolchain pins, the exact generator invocation, and the exact OpenAPI bytes the client was generated from. Verified by web/tests/guards/frontend-lock.guard.test.ts, which recomputes every digest here and fails if one has moved.

toolchain.no_floating_versions: Every dependency, devDependency, engines entry and packageManager value is an exact version. `save-exact=true` and `engine-strict=true` in web/.npmrc keep a later `npm install` from reintroducing a range. Enforced by web/tests/guards/pinned-versions.guard.test.ts.

openapi.content_commit_subject: CMP-SEAL-C3: close prose and recovery inventories
openapi.commit_note: CMP-SEAL-C3 adds 32 typed stage-comparison operations, 53 schemas, 28 paths and migration 0041 with fifteen project-reachable tables. The named commit holds these exact 1.12.0 OpenAPI bytes; preserve it when integrating.
openapi.read_only: The generated client and mirror come from the authored C3 contract; regenerate them from the exact contract bytes and compare digests before integration.

generator.determinism: Output is a pure function of the input bytes. No timestamp, hostname, absolute path or environment value is emitted; every iteration order is an explicit locale-independent sort, because localeCompare is locale-dependent. Two runs on the same document produce byte-identical files.

generated.hand_editing: forbidden; every file carries a do-not-edit header and the drift guard compares bytes

commands.makefile: none. OD-16 forbids adding a Makefile target for the frontend, so every command is `npm --prefix web run ...`.
